\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch12:12-4A lattice in $\mathbb {R}^n$ is an additive subgroup $\Lambda \subseteq \mathbb {R}^n$ of the form \[ \Lambda = \{ m_1 v_1 + \cdots + m_n v_n : m_1, \ldots , m_n \in \mathbb {Z}\} , \] for some basis $(v_1, \ldots , v_n)$ of $\mathbb {R}^n$. Let $T^n$ denote the $n$-torus.

  1. Show that if $g$ is a flat Riemannian metric on $T^n$, then $(T^n, g)$ is isometric to a Riemannian quotient of the form $\mathbb {R}^n/\Lambda $ for some lattice $\Lambda $, acting on $\mathbb {R}^n$ by vector addition.

  2. Show that two such quotients $\mathbb {R}^n/\Lambda _1$ and $\mathbb {R}^n/\Lambda _2$ are isometric if and only if $\Lambda _2 = A(\Lambda _1)$ for some $A \in O(n)$.

\end{exercise}
